probability_definition.explanation: The task-pinned deterministic SGLang input-logprob processor applies log_softmax to raw logits; temperature=0 selects decoding and does not scale input logprobs.
probability_definition.input_ids_from_source: Exact sample.tokens, without re-tokenization; the request itself is not recorded

evidence_limits: Request fields and probability semantics are source/launch-contract-derived, not sample-recorded receipts.
Teacher identity is startup model_info plus the frozen-teacher launch contract; no per-response model revision or consumed teacher weight version is recorded.

limits: Exact original loss-target/post-TIS survivor counts are not separately logged.
Gradient clipping is threshold-inferred; coefficient/postclip norm/update norm are absent.
Native reduced ratio scalars are not relabeled as complete global ratio extrema.
Monitoring probability/teacher identity semantics are source/launch-contract-derived.
Retrospective windows and sampled-token changes do not demonstrate convergence or capability.
